tools.name: list_connected_accounts
tools.description: List every social account the user has connected. Posts can only publish to connected platforms; use get_connect_url for anything missing.

tools.name: get_connect_url
tools.description: Get the URL of the ViewsMax Connections page where the user can connect a social platform. The user must open the page in a browser and click Connect there.

platform.description: Platform to connect (e.g. youtube, instagram, linkedin, x).

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List the user's brands, named groups of connected accounts. Pass a brand id to create_post as brand_id to post to every connected account in the brand.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Compose a social post for one or more platforms (tiktok, youtube, x, linkedin, threads, instagram, bluesky). Target either platforms[] or brand_id (from list_brands); one of them is required, including for drafts. status draft (default) saves without publishing, posted publishes immediately, scheduled publishes at scheduled_at. TikTok needs options.tiktok.privacy_level; ask the user. YouTube needs options.youtube.privacy_status; ask the user. Caption limits: tiktok 2200, youtube 5000, x 280, linkedin 3000, threads 500, instagram 2200, bluesky 300. Publishing is asynchronous: check with get_post.

platforms.description: Target platforms. Omit when brand_id is given.

brand_id.description: Post to every connected account in this brand instead of platforms.

scheduled_at.description: ISO-8601 datetime; required when status is scheduled.

overrides.description: Optional per-platform caption overrides, keyed by platform.

media.description: Media entries from upload_media (or any public URL).

options.description: Optional per-platform publish options, keyed by platform.

shorten_links.description: Replace URLs with tracked short links.

tools.name: update_post
tools.description: Edit a draft or scheduled post: caption, media, platforms, schedule, or status. Setting status to posted publishes immediately.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Fetch one post by id, including each platform target's publish status (pending, publishing, published, failed) and error message.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List the user's posts, newest first, with per-platform publish status. Filter by status and/or a scheduled_at window.

tools.name: list_outliers
tools.description: Browse outlier videos (outlier_score = views / channel average views) across YouTube, TikTok and Instagram. With query it returns title matches already in the database. If status is queued or in_progress no scrape has finished for that query yet: call search_outliers to start one, then re-run this tool. Paginated (per_page <= 50).

countries.description: ISO country codes of the channel.

tools.name: search_outliers
tools.description: Start a background YouTube search for outlier videos matching a keyword. Returns immediately with status queued; results land in list_outliers over the next minute or two. YouTube only: for TikTok and Instagram use fetch_outlier (single video URL) or add_outlier_channel (@handle).

term.description: Keyword or topic to search for.
